summary.en: Meta module for magic mount support

description.en: Mounts every module tree with magic mount and hides the result with the magic_hide kernel module: records are dropped from /proc/*/mountinfo, and stat()/statx()/statfs() on a replaced path still answer with the partition it covers.
description.zh: 使用 magic mount 挂载所有模块目录，并由 magic_hide 内核模块完成隐藏：从 /proc/*/mountinfo 中移除记录，同时让被替换路径上的 stat()/statx()/statfs() 返回其覆盖分区的身份。
